versions.content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00082, SRS_Rte_00091 The Client Identifier of the transaction handle used for an inter-ECU client server communication may be defined at the ClientIdDefinition belonging to the Ecu Extract and referring the operation instance. If defined the RTE generator shall take the clientId from the ClientIdDefinition . If not defined the RTE generator shall set the clientId to 0.
